title: AURASELECT - AI Video Interview Evaluator
tagline: Full-stack AI platform automating HR screening and video response evaluation
description: An AI-powered platform automating HR screening. Candidates record video responses, while behind the scenes Groq Whisper transcribes speech and LLMs semantically evaluate performance across multiple dimensions.

title: OpenViz - Generative AI Analytics Platform
tagline: Prompt-driven visualization engine powered by Llama 4 and Vega-Lite
description: React 19 & Vega-Lite visualization engine featuring a hybrid drag-and-drop/AI interface powered by Llama 4 via Groq SDK. Implemented a client-side RAG pipeline with Arquero for zero-latency data profiling.

title: SiLens AI - AI-Powered STEM Learning Platform
tagline: Interactive STEM platform converting textbooks into LaTeX math and interactive Q&A
description: Transforms static learning documents into interactive study experiences using OpenCV, PaddleOCR, and Pix2Tex for LaTeX math extraction, with a FastAPI backend and TanStack frontend for document Q&A.

title: AI File Explorer - Local AI Indexing & Search Platform
tagline: Privacy-first desktop AI app for semantic search across local files and codebases
description: Monitors local directories in real time using watchdog & PyMuPDF, ingests documents into ChromaDB vector search, and enables natural language interaction with local (Ollama) and cloud (Groq) LLMs inside Electron.

title: Meet-Ops - AI Meeting Analytics
tagline: Autonomous Teams meeting bot for transcript capture and AI insights
description: Autonomous meeting assistant bot that joins Teams calls, stores transcripts in PostgreSQL, and generates AI summaries and actionable insights displayed on a React dashboard.
